request: At the notes POST handler, assess two declared relations between an authenticated caller and an existing document. Both callers hold global add_note, view_document and change_document permissions and can view the document. Use each scenario's object relation to determine whether Note.objects.create is reached.

policySources.text: Creating a note requires the stated global permissions and object-level change_document authorization; a view grant alone is insufficient, while document ownership or an object change grant can satisfy the object control.

acceptance.reason: Task author supplied this bounded accepted policy for source comparison.

principals.role: authenticated caller described by the scenario premises
principals.description: Author facts: ["Entry identity and object relation are scenario premises."]

resources.description: Author facts: ["The target exists and its relation to the caller is fixed separately in each scenario."]

obligations.operation: create a note on the document
create a note on the document

scopeAssurance: Only explicitly declared scenarios and supplied source are assessed; repository discovery and deployment behavior are not tested.
requiredAnalysis: Trace entry, identity and resource binding, strongest authorization control, and protected effect. Explain decisive missing source-external facts.
constraints: Use only supplied fixed source context. Do not execute or modify the target, contact a deployment, or claim repository-wide discovery.
